title: Rate of Pelvic Inflammatory Disease at St. Michael's Hospital
brief_summary: A retrospective review of women who came through the ER at SMH with a pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) or tubo-ovarian abscess (TOA) between 1995-2005. They were looking at people with this diagnosis to determine how they were treated, whether as inpatient or outpatient and whether they were treated with drugs and how were these given and also did they develop an abscess.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women admitted to Emergency with pelvic-inflammatory disease or tubo-ovarian abscess from the year range: 1995-2000

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: Women with pelvic-inflammatory disease or tubo-ovarian abscess
